title: Consumer-side credential export or bearer mutation paths discovered beyond the initial installation-list baseline

paths.historical_pattern: Site --apply path requests a credential value through a TVC-shaped resolver, accepts the returned token in Site process state, constructs an x-access-token Git URL, clones a destination, commits, and pushes.

containment.resolver_state: CredentialExportProhibited; raw credential values are not returned to Site consumers

paths.historical_pattern: consumer helper accepted GH_TOKEN, built an x-access-token Git remote, pushed the exact M1 tag, queried GitHub API, and persisted result state
scheduled hosted workflow consumed STEGVERSE_RELEASE_TAG_TOKEN, built x-access-token push URL, created exact release tag, persisted commits, and closed issues
paths.canonical_authority: TVC only; GitHub token production authority NONE

paths.historical_pattern: hosted workflow consumed DELIVERABLES_TOKEN, cloned a private repo through x-access-token, copied STATUS/STATE, committed, and pushed

assessment: These paths demonstrate a historical design pattern in which a consumer repository could receive or process bearer credential material and perform GitHub mutations itself. Three newly discovered paths are now fail-closed/validation-only. Site's latent apply implementation remains in source but is unreachable because its live resolver refuses credential export. This is an authority/provenance finding, not evidence of malicious intent.
required_resolution: Resolve historical triggering actor/application/token provenance from GitHub organization/security audit logs.
Remove or refactor Site's latent token-accepting apply implementation under Site#398.
Keep Comms-Gateway M1 tag execution exclusively in its existing TVC exact-tag lifecycle.
Keep crypto-bot paper tag mutation exclusively in its existing TVC exact-tag task.
Do not restore StegOps private-deliverables mirroring without an explicit target-scoped TV/TVC mutation capability and secret-free receipt.
